verdict: Paid campaigns are off; organic is holding but starting to soften.
narrative: Paid advertising on both Meta and Google has been paused for the full 28-day window, meaning zero ad spend and zero paid leads this period. Organic search has carried the load — your site drew 1,643 sessions and 608 search clicks over the last 28 days — but that foundation is beginning to ease, with sessions and search clicks each down roughly 11% in the most recent 7 days. On top of that, your Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this past week, which is being investigated now as a potential listing issue. Restarting paid campaigns is the primary growth lever available, and that path forward is being worked through with your team this week.

highlights.phrase: website sessions this period, all driven by organic traffic
calls generated through your Google Business Profile this period
drop in Google Business Profile activity in the last 7 days — being investigated

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement collapsed in the last 7 days, with three consecutive days of near-zero activity after running at 5–12 actions per day prior.
watch_item.fix: A listing audit is underway now to identify and resolve any suppression; a consistent posting cadence will be restored by end of September.
